critique: The monumental patterned vessel, luminous star-filled cascade, and solitary robed figure form a bold, spare Afrofuturist myth, with cyan, magenta, and amber geometry striking cleanly against the low-key violet field. The five tiny edge-bound seed discs and nearly invisible guinea-pig thumbnail feel incidental rather than transformative; replacing those ornaments with one restrained motion that materially connects the figure, bowl, and cosmic stream would give the code-based presentation a stronger purpose.
